notes.title: Demo Update & Japanese language support
notes.content: [p]Thank you so much for all your support! 💖✨[/p][p][/p][p]Whether it’s through wishlisting the game, joining and being active in our Discord server, or showing love with likes and reposts on social media.[/p][p]Even when you leave reviews on the Steam demo page or fill out our feedback form, it truly means a lot![/p][p]Reading your thoughts and chatting with you has been a joy, and it all means the world to our small indie team.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now, K-pop Idol Stories has been selected as one of the Official Selections at BitSummit, Japan’s biggest indie game event.✨[/p][p]The game also joining Dames 4 Games Summer Showcase as an alumni from July 18–25, 2025✨[/p][p][dynamiclink href="http://twitch.tv/Dames4Games"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we’ll be showcasing our demo with Japanese language support at our booth at[/p][p]Miyako Messe, Kyoto, Japan, from July 18–20, 2025. 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]For those who can’t attend in person, don’t worry...[/p][p]We’re also updating the Steam demo! ☺️💖[/p][p][/p][p]This also means that the full version of the game will include Japanese language support at launch, along with support for other languages like Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Korean, and French.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 ✨ Here are a few things included in the K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut Version 0.4.425 Demo update:[/p][list][*][p]New: All White Costume.[/p][/*][*][p]New: Japanese language support.[/p][/*][*][p]Major UI adjustment.[/p][/*][*][p]New: trainees status graph.[/p][/*][*][p]New: Benefit difference between the 3 manager types.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved cutscenes and the animation.[/p][/*][*][p]More random events and interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved data and preview in the Schedule tree UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing and adjusting the difficulty in Audition mini games.[/p][/*][*][p]New and improved character's sitting pose.[/p][/*][*][p]New and improved shop items.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the responsiveness in some mini games, especially the Vocal Rhythm mini game.[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing improvement in data management.[/p][/*][*][p]More informative input prompt display in some UIs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix various game freeze, glitches and bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the issue with ultra wide screen resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41485522/327a541862d5b4dd7df0a4f8ed88cff07850b355.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41485522/9bc38a6e9f578abf39d367bab112038638c5b2f8.png"][/img][/p]

[h3][u][b]1. Update on Run Schedule UI[/b][/u][/h3]
As the game has a bit of variables and more characters for the management aspect, we did further study on the run schedule UI visual. 
We hope that the informations are clear and easy to understand, while maintaining the colorful and clean visuals.

Our team's favourite is weighted on C, but we would like to hear which one is your favourite?ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Storyteller's Festival: Leemar's Stream, Dev Insights & Play
notes.content:
It is our pleasure to announce that 'KISS: K-pop Idol StorieS - Road to Debut' is a part of the Storyteller's Festival 2024.
As we're still working hard on the upcoming demo (yes we do a lot of improvements), 
we would like to stream the 1st Playtest version played by our devs and LeeMar V, the super cute V-tuber from Malaysia.

You can support her on Twitch January 29th, 2024, Monday, 09.00 PM PST 
[url=https://twitch.tv/leemarv ]https://twitch.tv/leemarv [/url]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/tL7rVKG/KISS-Storytellers-Festival-Schedule-rev-10-2.jpg[/img]

Before we get the demo up, we may held the 2nd Playtest as a close playtest for our mailing list subscribers, discord members, and everyone who filled the playtest form before.
It will be announced around end of February or early March 2024. *finger cross!

We hope that you can give us your honest feedback, and maybe suggest us your language preferences?
As it will be the closest version to the public demo.

notes.title: December 2023 Dev Log: Poll Result
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! 🥰🎶
Welcome to the latest KISS update for December 2023.

Before concluding this year, we would like to share some progress and additions based on the last playtest feedback.

[h2][b][u] Idol Costumes[/u][/b][/h2]

Our team has prepared several costumes for you to choose for your idol group’s debut, and here's one of them:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/R27XRd9/Minji-ganti-baju.gif[/img]

Some trainees will have similar themed costumes with different styles.

Now, we're curious – which idol group do you think has a great style? Refer them to us for inspiration! Maybe we might use it as a reference for upcoming designs.


[h2][b][u] Review Text History [/u][/b][/h2]

We have added a feature that allows you to revisit the dialogs you have acquired before. 

To start with, here's the initial view (WIP) of the dialog history feature developed by our programmer while awaiting the UI design from the artist:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/7QHrjt5/devlognov-windowtexthistorywip.jpg[/img]

Then, our artist enhanced its appearance with an appealing UI design:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/6mXqMrf/Actual-E.png[/img]


[h2][b][u] Number of Trainees to Manage [/u][/b][/h2]

We conducted [url=https://twitter.com/WisageniGames/status/1719619789621199049]a poll on Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@wisagenistudio/video/7297216595816910086]TikTok[/url] some time ago. The result was that many feel 5-6 members are the ideal number for a K-pop idol group:

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/DM4J0cZ/Screenshot-2023-11-14-125801.png[/img]

But, how about you? If you missed the poll, feel free to share your thoughts by leaving a comment in the discussion below!


[h2][b][u] Stay tuned! [/u][/b][/h2]
Be sure to follow and wishlist KISS: Kpop Idol StorieS - Road to Debut so you won’t miss our future announcements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1662160/KISS_KPOP_Idol_StorieS__Road_to_Debut/
